notes.text: Ḥama’s patronymic is explicit in Kiddushin and has a matching Heilprin entry.
Berakhot’s first formulation gives Rav Shimi bar Ukva, with Mar Ukva as the alternate narrator. The patronymics alone do not establish which Ukva or that the fathers were one person.
Both patronymics are individually attested. Their shared father and his identity remain Heilprin’s grouping without an independent witness here.
